title: Drug target prediction through deep learning functional representation of gene signatures
body:
##  [ Drug target prediction through deep learning functional representation of gene signatures ](</content/reactome-research-spotlight/254-drug-target-prediction-through-deep-learning-functional-representation-of-gene-signatures>)

In their May 2024 Nature Communications paper, [Chen et al](<https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC10904399/>) used data simulated based on Reactome pathways to validate their Functional Representation of Gene Signatures (FRoGS) algorithm, a deep learning-based approach that was designed to improve the accuracy of drug target predictions by addressing limitations of gene identity-based pathway analysis.
